general.explicacion: View registered revisions of your service records within an effective-date interval.
general.intervalo_invalido: Check the dates. The end date must be later than the start date.
general.sin_consulta: Select the dates and choose View history.
general.cancelada: Query cancelled. You can change the dates and query again.
general.vacio: There are no revisions within the interval and information cutoff queried.
general.no_configurado: Service history is not yet available in this portal.
general.no_disponible: Service history could not be retrieved. Please try again.
general.denegado: You cannot view this history. Contact HR if you need access.
general.sesion_caducada: Your session has ended. Sign in again and query again.
general.excede_limite: The interval contains too many revisions. Narrow the dates and query again.
general.respuesta_no_valida: The response could not be verified. Please query again.
general.alcance: View revisions of your service record. Ask HR to confirm seniority or entitlements.
general.intervalo: Records effective from {desde} until {hasta}, excluding the end date.
general.desplazar: Scroll the list sideways to see all columns.

cobertura.completa: Complete coverage of the queried interval
cobertura.parcial: Partial coverage: the history may contain other revisions.
cobertura.no_acreditada: This information may be incomplete. Contact HR if you need to confirm your full history.

ayuda.periodos: Service start and end identify the days of service, both included. Effective dates relate to the administrative record.
ayuda.conocimiento: Information known as of fixes the revisions available when queried. Registered at identifies when each revision was recorded.
ayuda.versiones: You can view earlier revisions. Do not add up days to calculate seniority; ask HR to confirm it.
